verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP. Their status (healthy, violations found, connection errors) appears on a centralized Monitors page, and the product claims it alerts on compliance violations. However, the docs say monitors refresh data only 'up to daily or ad-hoc', so the story's 'within hours' detection window is not evidenced. missing for 10: documented sub-daily or hourly test cadence, detail on alert delivery and timing for failing controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous detection.

support.subject: As a security engineer, automated tests run continuously against my connected systems — failing controls surface within hours, not at the annual audit

citations.quote: Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Review their current status (healthy, violations found, connection errors)
Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
Monitors and integrations will be refreshing data up to daily or ad-hoc
